newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Three brothers among four killed in Malaysian fire.
newsitem.headline: Three brothers among four killed in Malaysian fire.

text.p: Three brothers and a female factory worker were burned to death in a fire on Monday at a house they were renting in a Kuala Lumpur suburb, the national news agency Bernama reported.

Police said the charred bodies of two of the brothers were found clutching each other in their room. All four were trapped in their rooms when the fire broke out around 3 a.m. (1900 GMT), police said.
The three brothers were identified as Andy, Edie and John Lau. The woman was identified as Soon Chui Yee. All four worked in nearby factories.
The two-storey house had nine rooms which were rented by 18 people, Bernama said. The others fled the house, some by jumping out of second-storey windows, the news agency said.
